defects.description: Description: one hand on the hip. L wrist→L hip dist2D=0.552, R wrist→R hip dist2D=0.712 (threshold <0.25). NEITHER hand on hip. L arm has leftShoulder=-35 (abduction ~59deg) + leftElbow=70 — upper arm below horizontal, forearm not folded to hip.

Description: the other on the breast. L wrist→neck dist2D=0.795, R wrist→neck dist2D=0.663 (threshold ~0.20 for chest/breast contact). NEITHER hand at chest. shoulderFwdR=10 (positive = BEHIND per CORRECTED convention) — R arm extended backward not forward to chest.

regression_risk: medium-high — six simultaneous joint changes including shoulderFwdR sign flip. Rig constraint may prevent full <0.25 threshold achievement. Integrator should verify both contacts via test render.
rationale: Six coordinated changes for one-hand-on-hip (L) + one-hand-on-breast (R). Per CORRECTED sign convention shoulderFwd -=forward. L hand to hip: (1) leftShoulder -35→-55 (raise upper arm to ~80deg abduction, elbow approaches shoulder height). (2) leftElbow 70→100 (deep flexion, forearm folds down toward hip). (3) shoulderFwdL 2→-10 (slight forward, hand in front of body for hip contact). R hand to breast: (4) rightShoulder -65→-25 (reduce outward abduction, arm more forward-facing). (5) shoulderFwdR 10→-50 (SIGN FLIP: positive=behind was wrong; -50=forward brings R arm in front of chest). (6) rightElbow 85→70 (slight reduction, forearm reaches chest not folded). Goal: L wrist near L hip, R wrist near neck/chest center. spine=-14 (PR-v3), globalTilt=5, hipAbductR=-15 (R leg crossing), rightKnee=45 (R leg bent) preserved.
